deferrals.note: The first product runs one primary agent; delegation is not a first-product capability.
Context packets are per-run inputs; nothing here promotes them to durable memory.
The name is reserved for forward compatibility; no memory ontology is frozen here.
One Workbench instance is authoritative; no peer agreement protocol is defined.
Rooms are local to the Workbench; no external messaging surface is contracted.
Projection families are conversation, activity, status, and inspector only.
Agent specifications are versioned and operator-authored, never self-promoted.
Capability reports state per-route truth; parity across routes is not claimed.
Deployment shape is unchanged by this package.
